Tune in to this melodious song Mere Dil Mein Halki Si from the super hit movie of 1963 Parasmani starring Geethanjali, Mahipal, Aruna Irani and Helen.
Movie: Parasmani
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyrics: Asad Bhopali
Cast: Geethanjali, Mahipal, Aruna Irani and Helen
Director: Babubhai Mistri
